keyPoints: Chaturbhuj banane ke liye kam se kam 5 swatantra naap chahiye — 4 bhujaen + 1 vikarn, ya 3 bhujaen + 2 vikarn.
Jab 4 bhujaen aur 1 vikarn diye hon: pehle vikarn se do tribhuj banao, phir parkar se bhujaen kaato.
3 bhujaen aur 2 vikarn diye hon to pehle vikarnon se tribhuj, phir teesri bhuja jodo.
Samantar chaturbhuj ki rachna me uske gun kaam aate hain — aamne-saamne ki bhujaen barabar lekar aasani se banta hai.
Vishesh chaturbhuj (varg, samachaturbhuj) kam naap me bhi ban jaate hain kyunki unke gun pehle se pata hote hain.
Rachna me scale se seedhi rekha aur parkar se sahi trijya ke chaap lagao — naap me safai hi sahi aakaar deti hai — halka chaap lagao taaki galti sudhar sako.
Aam galti: sirf 4 bhujaen lekar chaturbhuj banana — 4 bhujaon se anek aakaar ban sakte hain, isliye paanchvan naap (vikarn/kon) zaroori hai.

title: Chaturbhujon ki Rachna
